subject: Discovery recap: Helion Health buying ecosystem & billing gates
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Romero <alyssa@helionhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-15T15:02:00Z
Subject: Discovery recap: Helion Health buying ecosystem & billing gates

Thanks for the time today, Alyssa — great conversation. Quick recap and clear next steps so procurement has everything they need to move us forward. Please confirm any edits below.

Key stakeholders (as we understood):
- Economic buyer: Marcus Liao, CFO (final sign-off on spend)
- Security / Privacy: Naomi Patel (security review & questionnaire owner)
- Procurement / Payables: procurement@helionhealth.com (PO issuance & vendor onboarding)
- Technical champion: Dr. Priya Menon (integration lead)

Procurement & billing gates we heard:
- PO threshold: any ARR/commit over $50k requires a PO
- Invoice terms: net45 (Finance runs AP on the 1st of each month)
- Vendor onboarding: standard vendor portal + completed security questionnaire + W-9 / tax form
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II report + DPA required before production access

Decision criteria you called out:
- Latency SLA for inference under 200ms for critical flows
- Data residency assurances for PHI-bound workloads
- Clear unit economics (cost per 1k tokens) and predictable monthly billing

Our immediate next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll share a concise post-call packet (SOW draft + security packet) for procurement and security — targeted delivery by EOD tomorrow. [Attachment: redwood-postcall-recap.pdf]
2) Schedule a 30-minute procurement + finance walkthrough to complete vendor portal onboarding and PO logistics — proposed slot: Thursday 4/19 10:00am PT.
3) We’ll attach SOC 2 Type II and a DPA template for your legal/security review.
4) Ask: please confirm (a) whether Helion requires Redwood to complete an external vendor portal onboarding link, and (b) the expected decision timeline (target date) so we can align rollout.

If any of the stakeholder names above should change, flag it and I’ll update the packet.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting procurement operational.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-postcall-recap.pdf (870KB)]

From: Alyssa Romero <alyssa@helionhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, procurement@helionhealth.com
Date: 2028-04-16T11:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Helion Health buying ecosystem & billing gates

Thanks, Soojin — this is helpful. Confirmations and a couple of clarifying items below.

Confirmations:
- Marcus Liao (CFO) is the economic approver — he'll sign the PO once terms are finalized.
- Naomi Patel is indeed the security reviewer; she'll want SOC 2 Type II + an encrypted transfer assurance.
- Procurement contact is procurement@helionhealth.com (I’m looping them here).

Procurement specifics / asks from Finance:
- PO threshold: correct — anything over $50k requires an official PO.
- Net45 is our standard payment term. Payments process on the 1st of each month; if invoiced after the 15th, it generally falls into the next cycle.
- We use an external vendor portal (VendorLink) for onboarding — can Redwood complete VendorLink? If so, procurement will email an invite.
- We need a current W-9 for Redwood (tax). Could you attach that and a standard invoice sample?

Security/legal asks:
- Please provide SOC 2 Type II (latest) and a standard DPA; Naomi will circulate redlines if needed.
- Data residency: production data must stay in US regions for now.

Timeline: Our internal target is to have procurement complete and a PO approved by May 10 to hit a mid-May pilot start (around May 15). That’s aggressive but realistic if vendor onboarding goes smoothly.

One more: can you include an estimated monthly invoicing cadence in the SOW (e.g., monthly invoice on the 1st based on prior-month usage)? That helps Finance plan cashflow.

Thanks — procurement, if you need anything from our side to trigger the VendorLink invite, let us know.

Best,
Alyssa Romero
Head of Product Operations
Helion Health

Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Helion Health buying ecosystem & billing gates

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround, Alyssa. Short answers and follow-ups below.

Vendor portal: yes, Redwood can complete VendorLink onboarding. If procurement sends the invite to vendor-onboarding@redwood.ai we'll have our finance lead complete it the same day.

W-9 & invoice sample: attached.

SOC 2 & DPA: we’ll attach the latest SOC 2 Type II and a standard DPA. If Naomi has redlines we’ll work through them quickly.

Invoice cadence and SOW notes:
- Proposed: monthly invoice on the 1st covering prior calendar-month usage. If onboarding completes mid-month we can prorate the initial invoice.
- SOW draft will include the pricing table, billing cadence, and an explicit PO reference for Helion’s finance.

Proposed procurement walkthrough: Thursday 4/19 10:00am PT — I’ll calendar invite procurement@helionhealth.com and include a 15-minute pre-call for our finance to prep.

Deliverables we’ll send by EOD tomorrow (4/18):
- SOW draft (SOW-draft-v1.docx) [Attachment]
- SOC 2 Type II (pdf) [Attachment]
- DPA template (docx) [Attachment]
- W-9 and invoice example [Attachment]

If the timeline target May 10 PO / May 15 pilot is still accurate on your end, we’ll prioritize onboarding to meet that window.

Thanks — I’ll send the calendar invite shortly.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachments: SOW-draft-v1.docx; redwood-soc2-type2-2027.pdf; redwood-dpa-template.docx; redwood-w9.pdf]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-18T09:21:00Z
Subject: Internal: Helion pricing allowance suggestion

Quick internal note — if we want to speed the PO and pilot, recommend offering a 15% onboarding credit off list for the first 90 days (apply as a one-line credit on month-1 invoice). I’m authorized up to 20% for new mid-market pilots but prefer to keep this limited and tie the credit to a signed SOW and PO.

If you agree, Soojin/ Lauren: we can bake that into SOW-draft-v1 before we send it to procurement. Also confirm that Finance has a W-9 on file before VendorLink live invite.

Ben Carter
Director, Solutions Sales
Redwood Inference
